import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='49tAGZz'].copy()
prev = acc[acc.date=='10/12/2025']
cur = acc[acc.date=='10/13/2025']
key = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
m = prev.merge(cur, on=key, suffixes=('_prev','_cur'), how='outer', indicator=True)
m['delta'] = m.unblended_cost_cur.fillna(0) - m.unblended_cost_prev.fillna(0)
m = m[m.delta.abs()>1e-9]
print(m[['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','price_prev','num_instances_prev','unblended_cost_prev','price_cur','num_instances_cur','unblended_cost_cur','delta','_merge']].to_string())

prev = acc[acc.date=='10/12/2025']; cur = acc[acc.date=='10/13/2025']

print('price changed:', (m.price_p!=m.price_c).sum())
print('instances changed:', (m.num_instances_p!=m.num_instances_c).sum())
print(m[m.num_instances_p!=m.num_instances_c][key+['num_instances_p','num_instances_c']].to_string())
